corrected_code:
# app/views/posts/show.json.jbuilder
json.extract! @post, :id, :title, :content, :published_at

if current_user && (@post.user_id == current_user.id || current_user.editor?)
  json.author_private_tags @post.author_private_tags do |tag|
    json.name tag.name
    json.editorial_critique tag.critique_notes
  end
end
